about: Blast visuals built from TF2's own effect textures (camera-facing cards that grow and fade).

columns.fireTexture: assets row for the fireball cards
columns.fireCloudTexture: assets row for the outer fire cloud
columns.smokeTexture: assets row for the smoke cards
columns.spreadHU: how far cards drift from the centre
columns.lightRangeHU: range of the blast flash light (0 = no light)

rows.source: Textures from TF2's ExplosionCore particle materials (effects/fireball, effects/fire_cloud2, effects/smoke/smokelit); timings tuned by this mod to approximate it
